title: Keep one runtime receiver
explanation: Two variables refer to one HintPrinter. The base variable exposes PromptPrinter’s API; assignment does not change the object.

title: Choose a signature, then dispatch
explanation: A String argument selects print(String), whose runtime override runs. An Object variable holding the same String selects print(Object); that signature has no child override.

title: Search the declared receiver API
explanation: PromptPrinter has no print(StringBuilder) overload. Only the child-typed call can select it. Both calls still use the same receiver and builder.

title: Stop at the first applicable phase
explanation: For int 3, widening to long is available before boxing. An Integer expression already matches Integer without unboxing. With zero arguments, only the variable-arity invocation applies.

title: Refine the return contract
explanation: copy() overrides one signature, with a covariant HintPrinter return and no checked throws clause. Through base, the caller still sees PromptPrinter and must handle or declare IOException.
